test.description: Check that tool activity stays separate from evidence and cannot authorize automatic recovery.

source.name: CLI/MCP activity lifecycle and persistent collector cases

test.inputs: Owned temporary repositories receive registration, tool-start, duplicate, waiting-user and resumed events; policies request continuation and timeouts without a host adapter. Collector input also includes malformed and oversized frames.
test.expected: Duplicate or missing signals do not create passing evidence. Stop remains sticky; host capabilities and automatic continuation remain disabled. Collector recovers after malformed frames and retains bounded later activity.
